MLC Election 2026 ki siton par aa rahe natijon aur ghamasan ke bich bahubli neta va mokama vidhayak anant sinh (Anant Singh) ki pahli aur behad tikhi pratikriya samne aaee hai. jediyu se 6 sal ke lie nishkasit kie jane ke bad se hi surkhiyon men bane anant sinh patna men emaelsi chunav ke natijon aur apne samarthak pratyashiyon ki sthiti par patrakaron ke savalon se buri tarah bharak gae.
